novel_features.name: Resolution radar
novel_features.description: List every market resolving in the next N days, ranked by your position value when a wallet is provided. Stops you missing redemption deadlines.
novel_features.rationale: Joins markets.end_date + markets.closed locally with the Data API positions endpoint — no single API call returns this view, and no surveyed competing tool surfaces resolution-window queries at all.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When the agent is asked 'do I have any winnings to claim or positions about to settle', this is the single-command answer.

novel_features.name: Reward-yield ranker
novel_features.description: Rank reward-eligible markets by expected daily payout per dollar of capital at risk, given a target spread.
novel_features.rationale: Inverts Polymarket's published clobRewards.scoreShare formula across all markets at once using local SQL on the rewards + markets tables plus live book depth — neither the official Rust CLI nor any MCP server computes this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent is asked 'where should a market-maker park 10k for the next week', this is the answer with the math shown.

novel_features.name: Position drift snapshot
novel_features.description: For each position: entry price, current mid, min/max over a window, unrealized P&L drift, and a thawed/frozen flag based on current spread + book depth.
novel_features.rationale: Joins positions + activity (earliest BUY = entry) + snapshots (window) + live book locally; no competing tool returns entry attribution or an exit-ability flag.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When the agent must answer 'which of my positions are easy to close right now and which are stuck', this returns the full set with one call.

novel_features.name: Implied-probability diff
novel_features.description: Find tokens whose implied probability moved by more than a threshold over a time window. Supports a slug watchlist and arbitrary windows down to a few minutes.
novel_features.rationale: SQL window over the snapshots table joined back to market and event titles — works fully offline once synced, and replaces the news-shock detector use case via --watch + --window flags.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When the agent is asked 'what moved on Polymarket in the last hour', it gets a deterministic list rather than scrolling activity.

novel_features.name: Frozen research bundle
novel_features.description: Export every market matching a tag, event, or id list as a portable zip: markets + events + tags + full price history + book snapshot + holders. bundle import rehydrates into a fresh SQLite.
novel_features.rationale: First-of-its-kind across surveyed tools. Local-only operation over already-synced data — citation-grade reproducibility for research and reporting.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to defend a claim with a snapshot ('on May 23 the market priced X at 62 percent'), this produces the archive proving it.

novel_features.name: Redemption batch executor
novel_features.description: Discover every position in resolved markets and report the redeemable set with totals. In this build --broadcast is a documented stub (real on-chain ctf redeem needs go-ethereum + Polygon RPC, wired in v0.2); the default --dry-run produces the exact call set you can replay through the official Polymarket Rust CLI for live broadcast.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps the absorbed ctf redeem primitive in a loop over Data API positions; the official Rust CLI requires per-position invocation and no MCP server batches redemptions.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When the agent is told 'claim everything I've won', this turns a 4-step ritual into one command with a dry-run preview.

narrative.headline: Every Polymarket feature the official Rust CLI ships, plus six novel commands no Polymarket tool offers across resolution radar, reward yield, drift, diff, bundle, and batch redeem.
narrative.value_prop: polymarket-pp-cli mirrors the full Polymarket surface area (Gamma + CLOB + Data API + on-chain CTF) into Cobra commands with agent-native JSON, a local SQLite + FTS5 store, and an MCP server exposing the same tree. The novel commands answer questions that need joining markets + positions + activity + snapshots in one query — questions no individual endpoint can.
narrative.auth_narrative: Polymarket auth is layered. L0 (no auth) covers all of Gamma + most CLOB reads. L1 is an EIP-712 signature with your Polygon EOA private key (POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY) — required to derive L2 credentials and to sign every order. L2 is an HMAC API key/secret/passphrase triple, which once derived goes into POLYMARKET_API_KEY/_SECRET/_PASSPHRASE for header authentication on order placement, cancellation, and account data. In this build, auth derive is a documented stub — it validates POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY and prints the exact request shape Polymarket expects, but real EIP-712 signing is wired in v0.2 (requires go-ethereum). For now, run the official Polymarket Rust CLI's clob create-api-key to mint the L2 credentials, then paste them into the three env vars above.

quickstart.comment: Confirms reachability, distinguishes Cloudflare-block vs API-down vs auth-tier mismatch, and tells you exactly what env vars to set next.
No auth, returns active election markets with implied probabilities — the first thing most users actually want.

quickstart.command: polymarket-pp-cli sync --resources markets,events,tags && polymarket-pp-cli search 'fed rate' --agent
quickstart.comment: One-shot offline FTS5 once synced — works without further API calls.
Once POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY is set, this signs an EIP-712 challenge and writes the derived L2 creds — the bootstrap that unlocks trading.
Novel command — what's resolving in the next 168h (7d) for the wallet, ranked by current position value.
Lists every claimable position before sending a single transaction — a safe way to preview the batch.

troubleshoots.fix: Datacenter IPs (Vercel, Fly, AWS, Supabase Edge) are routinely blocked by Polymarket's Cloudflare WAF. Workarounds today: (1) run from a residential connection; (2) route through Cloudflare WARP; (3) put a residential proxy in front. A built-in browser-fingerprinting transport is planned for v0.2.

troubleshoots.symptom: auth derive returns 'no PRIVATE_KEY in env'
troubleshoots.fix: Export POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY=0x... (your Polygon EOA, hex, 0x-prefixed). The CLI never writes the PK to config — it's read fresh each call.

Polymarket markets have variable tick sizes. Add --tick-size 0.01 (or fetch the market's required size via polymarket-pp-cli markets get <slug> --select clobRewards.minSize). The --preflight flag previews this without sending.
Trading endpoints cap at 60 orders/second sustained. Use the adaptive limiter that ships with the CLI; for bursty workloads add --rate-limit 50/s to throttle conservatively.

troubleshoots.symptom: ctf redeem reverts with 'not yet resolved'
troubleshoots.fix: Markets need both accepting_orders=false AND on-chain resolution. radar resolutions distinguishes 'closed' from 'redeemable' — wait for the latter before batching.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when an agent needs to query, analyze, or trade on Polymarket programmatically. It is the strongest choice when the task involves cross-entity joins (positions + markets + activity), time-window analysis (price diffs, drift), or batched on-chain actions (redeem all). Skip it for raw single-endpoint pulls when the user already has a thin SDK — the value here is the SQLite store, novel commands, and MCP surface, not endpoint mirroring alone.

recipes.title: Walk a market's order book for a $5k taker
recipes.explanation: Walks the live order book for one outcome token to project the average fill price + slippage vs midpoint + market-impact bps for a $5,000 USDC taker. Pure read, no auth, no order sent.

recipes.title: Daily portfolio check
recipes.explanation: Single command returns drift over 24h with the exit-ability flag, narrowed to the three fields most decisions actually use.

recipes.title: Rank reward markets for a maker bot
recipes.explanation: Returns the top markets by expected daily payout per dollar of capital, with the math (depth-share, score-share, expected USDC) shown per row.

recipes.title: Snapshot a research topic
recipes.explanation: Zips every 2026-election market + every price-history point + holders + book snapshot. The zip ships with a sha256 line in the report so the snapshot is citation-grade.

recipes.title: Detect overnight movers in a watchlist
recipes.explanation: Filters synced snapshots to a two-slug watchlist, surfaces moves >5c over the last 24h, narrows the response to the four fields an agent actually needs to act on.
